prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with wrist fracture after a rear-end collision. The patient had 27 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1435; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury is plausible for a crash like this one.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Imaging and exam findings clearly confirm the injury.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: The patient presented following a rear-end motor vehicle collision with a wrist fracture that is consistent with the mechanism of injury described. Imaging and examination findings clearly confirm the fracture, and there is no record of any prior injury to the same area. Care was delivered over 27 visits and followed a typical course, with immobilization, physical therapy, and graduated strengthening exercises. Visit frequency tapered as function returned and pain decreased, and the patient has progressed to independent home exercise with only occasional residual stiffness reported at the most recent review. Billing records reflect single, appropriate charges for each service rendered, with no duplicated or repeated entries. Continued self-management and a follow-up assessment are recommended if symptoms change.
